name: Graffiti
description: A black wall, a white contour, and a tag's hard color hit.
bestFor: Street-styled pages that should feel sprayed, not typeset.
promptFragment: Visual style: Graffiti. Use a black wall, a white contour, magenta and cyan hits, and a heavy condensed face. The shadow is a hard offset in a second bright color, like a sticker on brick. Avoid quiet paper, a thin serif body, and soft corporate shadows. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
